_: The Infinite Dreams' trials: the dream hub's «Pruebas» tab starts each from its seed, as a code.
From the client: InfiniteDreamTrialsDataRoot gives the id, the seed, the achievement and its
intensity, which is the trial's difficulty (4, 5 and 6 the Paradojas I to III, 8 the Pesadilla I:
the dofuspourlesnoobs guide 'Épreuves de Songe' plays them at exactly those). The achievements'
one objective is «EJ>achievement,0», «Vencer en el combate final de la prueba ...».
incarnation  the monster each player fights as. The client's data names them: REVERSED's
«Retazos de guardián» (8211), whose starting spell proposes choice 33, «Elige al
guardián de mazmorra que deseas encarnar»; DOFOUSSE's «Púrpura» (8350), whose
«Gameplay jugador» proposes choice 95, Yoy, RamboPL, Snyler or Crvor; SINJSONJ's
«Simueño» (8264), «¡Te has transformado en Simueño!», whose starting spell summons
its «Monórico» (8265). The guide: «Bosses have their spells but not their passives»,
«each Sinj summons a Sonj», «All have equal stats, except Cruor».
everyoneCarries  a spell every fighter of the trial's fights holds as an attitude: NILEZAFF's
«Cohobación Onírica» (31891), whose description is the trial's own.
monsterLifePercent  more life for the monsters and their summons: FONSOCAC's «vitality doubled,
including enemy summons» (the guide); the client only says «PdV adicionales».
enemies      the monsters of every room instead of the world's groups: REVERSED's «Bribes
d'aventurier», the race «Retazos de aventurero» (327) less its templates.
rareEnemies come one draw in ten (the guide: «The Féca is rarer»); lateEnemies only
from the fourth band and in the last room («the Roublard appears only in palier
IV-V hard rooms and the final room»). INFERRED: the one in ten.
